label: suspect

unstated.what: The unknown-slug warning must be written to stderr (tests grep the err file, not stdout) and must include the offending slug value.
unstated.quote: grep -q 'unknown-slug' err || fail "F1 missing unknown-slug warning"

unstated.what: When the default CSV cannot be opened, the stderr diagnostic must contain the literal path "styles/fixtures/default_names.csv".

When a translation CSV is missing, the stderr diagnostic must contain the concrete locale path "styles/locale/cs/names.csv" (the per-language path format is not spelled out as required in the message).
When the default CSV lacks a column, the stderr diagnostic must mention the missing column name (e.g. "slug").
When the translation CSV lacks the language-specific column, the diagnostic must mention it as "name_cs" (derived name_<lang_code> spelling).

reasons: The instruction covers the data semantics and failure conditions; the only unstated bits are diagnostics going to stderr and the exact message content (file paths / column names), which are largely derived from the paths and columns the instruction itself names, so they are graded guessable.
